categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput in src/psbt.cpp which dictates the behavior of the joinpsbts RPC, tested in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug in joinpsbts where leftover Taproot and MuSig2 signatures and nonces were not cleared, preventing downstream signing or finalizing without manual intervention. While a clear correctness fix for returned RPC data, PSBT joining with pre-signed Taproot inputs is a narrow workflow and reasonably deferrable.

categories.rationale: The wallet category definition explicitly excludes PSBT changes that affect only RPC without touching wallet code.
